text: Na-eui sowon-eun daehan-ui wanjeonhan jajugangrip-i-yo, du beonjjae sowon-do daehan-ui jaju-yo, se beonjjae sowon-eun daehan-ui wanjeonhan tong-il-ida.
Yeoksa-reul ijeun minjog-ege mirae-neun eopda. Jinan nal-ui apeum-eul gieokhago hyeonjae-ui balgeol-eum-eul dandanhi haeyaman binnaneun nae-il-eul majihanda.
Modeun saram-i pyeonhago swibge igyeo nalmada sseume pyeon-an-khe hagoja hal ttareum-inira. Hangeul-eun baekseong-eul saranghaneun maeum-eseo bakkueotda.
Mul-eun eotteon geureus-edo matchueo moyang-eul bakkudeusi, jihye-roun sarang-eun sanghwang-e yuyeonhage daeeunghade jasin-ui geunbon gachireul ilhji anhneunda.
Naui jugeum-eul jeog-ege alliji mara. Kkeutkkaji yong-gi-reul ilhji malgo nawa hamkke baekseong-gwa joguk-eul jikyeonaera.
source: Admiral Yi Sun-sin, Battle of Noryang
